title: Incident Autopilot I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 125. SCOPE CUT (see dispatch.py's own module-section docstring): prompt.md's triggers (a guardrail breach, an anomaly from Fn 100, a reputation alert from Fn 75) name two functions (100, 101+) that do not exist in this repo -- there is no live detector anywhere that watches published content for a breach after the fact (every existing QA gate runs BEFORE publish, not after). This PR wires the diagnose + draft-recovery half for a MANUALLY-SUPPLIED incident report (envelope.metadata, same mechanism proof_circuit already uses), plus a real standing-permission suspend side effect -- never an automatic trigger, which this repo has no detector to drive, and never the 'pause the affected lane' Contain step, which needs a kill-switch mechanism this repo does not have either. Registered and directly testable, no scheduled loop entry -- the same precedent report_month_end_handler already sets for a real, dispatch-ready handler with no wired trigger yet.

incident_description.description: What was observed -- never fabricated by this function; supplied by whoever reports the incident.

reached_an_audience.description: Whether the affected content actually reached an audience -- gates whether 'delete silently' may be recommended.

failure_class.description: The blueprint's nine failure classes -- named, not enumerated here, since prompt.md itself is the source of record for the list.

eval_case_summary.description: The Fn 112 harness case this incident should become, in prose -- dispatch.py does not itself write the case file in this PR (see module docstring).
